strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.деревня Рупосово (ныне Рубцово), Рязанск: the village of Ruposovo (now Rubtsovo), Ryazan uyezd
strings.Назван в рязанской судной грамоте 1530-х: Named in a Ryazan court charter of the 1530s as one of the peasants of the grand-princely villages of Podkletnoye and Starotumovo and as a participant in the inquest into the origin of the village of Ruposovo. In the line two peasants follow the two settlements, so it is not yet possible to determine from which village exactly Anfilog came.
strings.Анфилог — личное имя; Иванов сын — прямо: Anfilog is a personal name; Ivanov syn is a direct patronymic; Konstyantinova is an old spelling of an additional family or patronymic naming.
strings.Он давал показание по крестному целовани: He gave testimony under oath on the cross (krestnoye tselovanie), together with other local peasants, about the antiquity of the monastery's land and the origin of the settlement.
strings.В том же деле происхождение соседнего Ми: In the same case the origin of the neighbouring Mitusovo is explained by a direct formula: the place was so called because the groom Mitus lived there. This is the exact model of evidence that is still lacking for Onfilogovo.
strings.Человек особенно важен как подтверждение: This person is especially important as confirmation that the full form Anfilog was borne in the relevant period by a real peasant, not only by a bookish saint or a landowning serviceman.
strings.Именной указатель III тома Свода А. И. Ц: The name index of volume III of A. I. Tsepkov's Svod (compendium) normalises him as «Анпилог (Анфилог) Иванов сын Константинова, крестьянин» ["Anpilog (Anfilog) Ivanov syn Konstantinova, peasant"]. A complete check of the indexes of all four volumes revealed no other bearer of the stems Anfil-/Anpil-/Onfil-/Ampil- and no sons of this man with the patronymic Anfilogov. Therefore the Ryazan entry remains an isolated candidate, not a ready pedigree leading to Oryol.
strings.Рупосово из судебного дела продолжает су: The Ruposovo of the court case continues to exist as the village of Rubtsovo in Ryazan district; it was there that the sovereign's inquest took place, and this documentary point is placed on the map. A local-history publication places the vanished Podkletnoye between present-day Strakhovo and Tyapkino on the Sknizhka; the editor allows Starotumovo to be read as Starodumovo.
strings.Это сильнейшая прямая социальная паралле: This is the strongest direct social parallel for the peasant version of the eponym, but not a proven founder of the Tver Onfilogovo: there is no geographical or ownership bridge.
strings.Анфилог — личное имя; Иванов сын — отчес: Anfilog is a personal name; Ivanov syn is the patronymic. The form Konstyantinova may be an additional family naming, but its exact structure requires checking the original.
strings.Слово «крестьянин» стоит в самом источни: The word «крестьянин» ["peasant"] stands in the source itself; it is not an inference from context.
strings.Грамота относится к 1530-м годам, то ест: The charter dates from the 1530s, so Anfilog was an adult contemporary of the first scribal record of the Tver Onfilogovo in 1539/1540.
strings.Он не назван жителем спорного Рупосова и: He is not named as a resident of the disputed Ruposovo or as a monk of the Olgov Monastery. He was called as one of the grand-princely people of the neighbourhood able, under oath on the cross, to confirm the memory of the land and the settlement.
strings.Человек с точной формой имени участвовал: A man with the exact form of the name took part in proceedings about the antiquity, founding and ownership of a village — the closest analogue in genre to the evidence sought about Onfilogovo.
strings.Что значит «кто деревню поставил»: What «кто деревню поставил» ["who set up the village"] means
strings.Обыск связывает возникновение недавнего: The inquest links the emergence of a recent settlement to the actions of specific people. This proves that the question of a village's founder was understood literally by contemporaries and could be preserved in the memory of neighbours.
strings.Свидетели объяснили другое название форм: The witnesses explained another name by a formula: the old settlement site (selishche) is called Mitusovo because the groom Mitus lived there. Such a causal line is exactly the level of evidence that is still lacking for the Tver Onfilogovo.
strings.Почему это лучший образец крестьянина-эп: Why this is the best example of a peasant eponym
strings.Здесь совпадают полная форма Анфилог, пр: Here the full form Anfilog, an explicitly stated peasant status, the right decade and a document on the origin of a village coincide. No other namesake found combines all four features.
strings.Рупосово — современное Рубцово Рязанског: Ruposovo is present-day Rubtsovo in Ryazan district. A local-history publication locates Podkletnoye between present-day Strakhovo and Tyapkino on the Sknizhka; in the publication the reading Starotumovo is accompanied by the variant Starodumovo. The act does not assign Anfilog and Isay by name to the two settlements.
strings.Рязанский уезд, Рупосово, Подклетное и С: Ryazan uyezd, Ruposovo, Podkletnoye and Starotumovo are not linked by any document to Nikolskoye Svechino or the Yurlovs.
strings.Нужен документ о его службе, родне или з: What is needed is a document about his service, kin or land in Tver uyezd, or an act linking him to the Yurlovs and Nikolskoye Svechino. Without such a bridge the Ryazan peasant must not be transferred to Tver.
strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII РАН), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.В 1530-х годах великокняжеский крестьяни: In the 1530s the grand-princely peasant Anfilog Ivanov syn Konstyantinova took part in the sovereign's inquest into the origin and land of the village of Ruposovo.
strings.КТО НАЗВАН. В рязанской судной грамоте 1:
WHO IS NAMED. In a Ryazan judicial charter of the 1530s, Anfilog Ivanov syn Konstyantinova is explicitly named as a grand-princely peasant from Podkletnoye or Starotumovo. The personal name, patronymic and social estate stand in the source itself. The phrase lists two peasants after two settlements but does not show unambiguously who came from which village.

WHERE THE CASE TOOK PLACE. Ruposovo has survived under the altered name Rubtsovo in the present-day Ryazan district. The Ryazan toponymic dictionary explicitly equates the Ruposovo of the 16th–17th-century scribal books with the later Rubtsovo. Therefore the point on the map shows the documented place of the sovereign's inquest, not Anfilog's presumed home village.

WHY HE WAS QUESTIONED. The sovereign's inquest established the ownership of the land, the age of Ruposovo and the specific question of who had founded the village. Anfilog was part of a large group of local people who confirmed under oath by kissing the cross the old possession of the Olgov monastery.

WHY THIS IS ESPECIALLY IMPORTANT. In the same case the origin of a neighbouring name is explained literally: the old settlement site was called Mitusovo because the groom Mitus lived there. This is an exact model of the lost formula one would like to find for Onfilogovo: a person's name, his residence and the reason for the name in a single line.

LIMIT OF THE CONCLUSION. Anfilog proves the reality of a peasant with this personal name in exactly the right period and makes the scenario of a peasant first settler historically plausible. But this act does not connect Ryazan uyezd with Nikolskoye Svechino, the Yurlovs or Tver uyezd; it is the strongest social parallel, not a found eponym.
strings.Проверить палеографию формы «Констянтино: Check the palaeography of the form «Констянтинова» ["Konstyantinova"] on l. 212 of the original case file.
No connection with Onfilogovo in Tver has been found.
